content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a basic question. I have two units of [product_name] and want to connect them together. Every tutorial I find uses FBD language, but I prefer to work with Ladder. Is there any tutorial available for Ladder? FBD is not suitable for me. What settings do I need for ethernet connection and how do I use network input/output in Ladder? Thanks for any help. [user_name]
Why do you want the devices connected as master/slave? Why not set up both as masters?
It's not important to have master/slave, if master/master works better then that's fine.
With master/slave configuration, only the master [product_name] has a program; the slave [product_name] does not.
I have switched to a master/master setup. For my simple machine, master/master works better.
Here's a basic example for master/master connection using Ladder language.
